name: chronicle-monorepo
description: Chronicle - AI Code Decision Archaeology Tool

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend/react-app --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix frontend/vue-app --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/react-app" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/vue-app"
